decisions.question: Unit prices when the Price List API refuses the role
decisions.answer: Read the public AWS price list offer files for eu-north-1 (anonymous HTTPS, no account access). Each price records the offer file read (source_url), the public page (page_url, not read) and the date.
decisions.reason: STEPS.md point 4 provides a fallback when the API is refused. The offer files are the price list the API serves.
decisions.consequence: deploy/aws/pricing/eu-north-1.json; R14_04_agent-offer-extract.json (13 SKUs). Ticket criterion 2 rests on it; operator to confirm.

decisions.reason: AWS convention, not read from a page.
decisions.consequence: Affects only the gp3 volume share of the hourly figures (0.000916 USD/h).
